extracted.name: Vanishing Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
extracted.description: Classic oatmeal raisin cookies make tasty after-school snacks or lunchbox treats.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups Quaker® Oats (Quick or Old Fashioned, uncooked)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Beat butter and sugars together in a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Add combined flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; mix well.
Add oats and raisins; mix well.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until light golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool briefly on cookie sheets; remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Store tightly covered.
